description: This file defines a service class 'SampleMediaRouteProviderService' that extends Android's 'MediaRouteProviderService'. It overrides the 'onCreateMediaRouteProvider' method to instantiate and return a 'SampleMediaRouteProvider' object, demonstrating how to register a custom media route provider service using the support library.

classes.name: SampleMediaRouteProviderService
classes.description: A service class extending MediaRouteProviderService that registers a custom media route provider.

methods.name: onCreateMediaRouteProvider
methods.description: Overrides the method to create and return an instance of SampleMediaRouteProvider.
